observations.behavior: Adds a lookup table and conditional return for the new `monitoring_timing.state` field, including a fallback to the existing lane-based status.

observations.behavior: Adds a 60-second polling interval for checks with `monitoring_timing` and a 5-second interval for report status, while gating the 60s poll on the report status not being RESOLVED or SUPPRESSED.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a periodic refresh of check timing while the report is active and not resolved, without hammering the API when the report is already resolved or suppressed.
